name: Interaction
description: Configures what gets captured from live usage. Not a test runner — controls long-term analytics logging depth.

notes.tools_sent: Log the full tools array sent to the LLM — lets you see exactly what wording the model saw
notes.story_id: Tag each entry with which story was active
notes.slot_fill_rate: Track whether expected slots were filled vs empty
notes.options_config: Snapshot the options at time of call — catches config changes over time
